role: The anvil's ItemBlock: places the anvil block with its damage value shifted left two bits into the facing/damage metadata.
scope_reason: The anvil GUI is switched off (world.conf anvil = off), but the anvil is still a placeable plain block, so the item's placement behavior stays live.

members.name: ItemAnvilBlock
members.note: the generated row carries the class_name ItemAnvilBlock and the block id

members.name: getMetadata
members.note: place.c answers damage << 2 for class_name ItemAnvilBlock

notes: The anvil block's own GUI and repair behavior are out of scope (world.conf anvil = off); this file only places the block.
